guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Upgrade must fail closed when active Work Items exist unless --upgrade-with-active is explicit.
Rollback backups must remain available until the upgrade is reviewed.

risk.detail: Review the managed diff and rollback backup before commit.

observedIssues.issue: The checked-out v0.5.70 tag carries older release.json metadata (v0.5.69/local source), while the Git tag, version.json, source commit, and verified release archive identify v0.5.70.
observedIssues.resolution: Pinned the active Contract to the published v0.5.70 tag and repository URL, retained the generated install sourceCommit fact, and recorded the archive SHA-256 in the feature checklist evidence.

observedIssues.issue: An unrelated background make ai-finish process targeted the sentinel repository during the install session.
observedIssues.resolution: Terminated the out-of-scope process group; the official installer log independently ends with install complete and no sentinel process remains.

observedIssues.issue: The existing coverage policy treated each changed AI Cockpit script as requiring a matching test association, so the first finish attempt was blocked despite the new checklist test.
observedIssues.resolution: Added one narrowly scoped aiCockpitUpgradeFeatureChecklist association to the preserved project coverage policy; the association points to the checklist regression test and does not alter reportOnly or existing associations.

observedIssues.issue: The published v0.5.70 source carries a release-freeze projection whose releaseTag remains v0.5.62.
observedIssues.resolution: Retained the projection because it is identical in the published v0.5.70 source and the template main comparison checkout; no separate release-projection repair was requested in this adopter upgrade.

residualRisks.detail: Backup cleanup remains a human-reviewed follow-up.
The generated lifecycle identity is now a tagged v0.5.70 release with five source-bound artifact digests; the upstream release.json metadata mismatch remains documented above.
The published v0.5.70 release-freeze projection still names v0.5.62; it is retained unchanged because the same projection is present in both published source and template main.

Template main contains candidate-only history/projection files and a restore-project-test-receipt Make target not present in published v0.5.70; the installed catalog/runtime surface is fully parity-checked, but adopting unreleased candidate deltas would require a separate explicit decision.

reviewReadiness.reason: All required verification passed; residual risk remains documented.

intentAlignment.rationaleValidated: The official installer completed on a dedicated branch; catalog/runtime parity and preserved ownership decisions are recorded as evidence.

overclaimPrevention: Do not report upgrade completion as merged or published.
